POUND CAKE

Preview · simulated kick + 808 on CH 2 // 92.5 FM

Click POUND or CAKE to set this instance's role. Drag the Bake knob up or down. Tap the left or right side of the display to change station; any station other than CH 2 drops the link. Pick a flavor from the caps.

Preview sound is a quick browser sketch of the groove and flavors, not the plugin's DSP. Inside the plugin the panel runs on the Audio Unit's live telemetry instead.
